title: Slovakian Duck Confit
description: A hearty Slovakian-inspired dish featuring slow-cooked duck confit, rich and tender. This recipe is perfect for a special occasion dinner.
instructions: Rinse the duck legs and pat them dry with paper towels.
Season the duck legs with confit spices, salt, and black pepper.
Heat 1 tablespoon of butter in a large Dutch oven over medium heat.
Sear the duck legs until browned on both sides, about 5-7 minutes.
Transfer the Dutch oven to the preheated oven and cook for 2 1/2 hours, or until the meat is tender and falls off the bone.
While the duck is cooking, caramelize the fried onions in a pan over medium heat.
Add the sliced pears to the pan with the fried onions and cook for an additional 2-3 minutes.
Remove the duck from the oven and let it rest for 10 minutes.
Serve the duck confit with the caramelized onions and pears.
Garnish with additional fried onions and serve immediately.
